# Pollinations account

> Sign in, manage API keys, and check your credit balance for the Pollinations API and CLI. Balances and prices are in US dollars.

## For agents and developers

- [Agent and CLI entry point](https://gen.pollinations.ai/llms.txt): Task recipes, CLI skill, API reference, OpenAPI schema, and MCP server.
- [Create an API key](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys): Sign in and manage keys.
- [Credit balance](https://enter.pollinations.ai/pollen): Check prepaid credit in US dollars.
